segments.text: A former female admiral of thee Neo-Terras. She is the commander of the Kushan Army, the most powerful warlord on Mars.

She is feared as the 'Empress' because of her cruel political skills. She is an ambitious woman with plans to rule the universe with an iron fist. She possesses a charisma that fascinates her general, a supreme attitude, unparalleled beauty, and an attractive body comparable to that of a succubus.
Her daughter is Kira, but her husband's identity is a secret.
It is rumored that the Kushan Army is made up of the missing people form the lost lands of Earth. This is seen as why they pledge absolute loyalty to her.
元ネオ・テラ―ズの女提督。
火星最強の軍閥クシャナ軍を率いる司令官。
その苛烈な政治手腕から”女帝”と恐れられる。
宇宙をその手にしようと野望を抱く野心家。
神算鬼謀の用兵と将兵を魅了するカリスマ、壮烈な覇気と類まれなる美貌、時に魔女と評される魅力的な肉体の持ち主。
娘（キラ）を持つ母でもある。夫が誰であるかは秘密にしている。
クシャナ軍は今では地図から消えた地球のある地域の出身者ばかりで構成されているとされ、末端の新兵に至るまで彼女に絶対の忠誠を誓うのはそのためであると噂されている。

A former Neo-Terra soldier, who used to go to a school made up of the children of the highest ranking Neo-Terran offices.
She is currently a lieutenant in the Kushan Army, the most powerful warlord on Mars, and the pilot of an armored aircraft.
An ace pilot that is the center of the Kushan Army.
Feared as the 'Grim Reaper of Sand' She has sunk countless battleships and is feared by many people.
The daughter of Beatrice, her father's identity is unknown.
Kira has the good looks of her mother, but her exotic brown skin was potentially influenced by her father.
Using her natural physical abilities, she is an expert in combat knife fighting.
She is also her mother's personal bodyguard.

A Universal Federation Army Commander. A senior investigator belonging to the army military police investigation department. A beautiful woman commissioned officer who has a lovely, calm, cool, and collected judgment. She is a New Solar, being born on Planet Titan. She is heading an investigation regarding the unlawful activities being conducted by the Neo Terrors' politicians. Having witnessed the cesspools the Neo Terrors have covered with injustice and corruption, it is her conviction that the only way to peace in the galaxy is through getting the New Solars fired up with justice and an ideal by exposing the Neo Terrors' injustice again and again. She has become popular with the New Solars' citizens from those achievements and her lovely features, the New Solars' reasons being praised extravagantly due to her.
From Dark Translations

A Universal Federation Army Major. A New Solar born on Planet Titan. Naomi Evans is an aide to the investigators in the army military police investigation department. Learning to operate the self-propelled robot soldier called the "Gun Turtle" is said to be extremely difficult, but Naomi is able to operate as many as 4 at once. Excelling in close combat herself as well, she has won two championships in Titan's hand-to-hand tournaments. Originally, she was the eldest daughter of the mercantile house associating with House Bishop, but because of her time spent as a child with Lieri, she walked the path of military personnel in the steps of Lieri. Naturally, with going to the same government school as Lieri, Lieri has become more than just Naomi's senior officer, thinking of each other as true sisters. Because of Lieri's influence on her, she considers the savage, mass ideologies of the Neo Terrors, antiquated. Again, because of her superiority, she often attracts trouble from the male soldiers who look down on her as being bossy and arrogant.
From Dark Translations

軍憲兵捜査部所属の捜査官で、リエリの副官を務めている。
宇宙連邦軍の陸戦部隊に正式採用されている自走ロボット兵“ガンタートル”を4機同時に操れる天才。
また格闘術にも優れ、惑星タイタンで開催される格闘大会で二度優勝した経験を持つ。
幼い頃からリエリと行動を共にしていた彼女は、憧れていたリエリの後を追うように軍職に就く。
彼女自身、優秀であるが故に、自分よりも劣る男を蔑み、馬鹿にする傾向にある。
また、リエリの影響でネオ・テラーズ派を良く思っていない。

segments.text: Commander of the Cordelia army. Regent and Duchess of Cordelia.
A talented woman with the beauty and charisma of a champion.

After the assassination the Archduke and the Marquis (her father and uncle), she became the guardian of her successor and cousin, Maya Cordelia, and has since led Cordelia to become a military power with great influence on the Neo-Terras and New Solars.
As the hero of Cordelia, she is immensely popular with her subjects, and is revered as a true warrior who is loyal to Maya, despite practically ruling the country.
As a soldier, she serves as the Captain of Cordelia's own invented forces, the Armored Cavalry Force, and is a known as a brave general who takes command of the front line herself.
She dotes on Maya, and supports her every way to make her a worthy Archduke. She more of a mother than a cousin.
As a result of the battle between the Neo-Terras and the New Solar, she decided to ally with the latter. Due to this, the aura of Donny Bohgan soon comes.
本作のヒロイン。
コーデリア軍司令長官。コーデリア公国摂政。
先代、イェルド・コーデリア大公の弟レイフ・ビューストレーム伯爵の娘。
持って生まれた王者の威風と華麗な美しさを持つ才女。
政治・軍事に優れ、科学技術にも造詣が深く、イェルド大公とレイフ侯爵が相次いで暗殺されると幼い後継者マヤ・コーデリアの後見人として摂政となり、それまで辺境の小国に過ぎなかったコーデリアを、ネオ・テラーズやニュー・ソラルに大きな影響を及ぼす軍事強国に導く。
マヤ・コーデリアを溺愛しており、彼女を立派な大公にすべくあらゆる面でサポートしている。
「マヤ、お前にはあまり危ないことはさせたくないのだ」

Daughter of the former Archduke of Cordelia, as her fathers only child, she will become the new leader one day.
Like Alicia, she is popular among her subjects. Protected by Alicia, she learns less about the empire then her cousin does.
A genius and hard-worker, Alicia is dependent on her in the future.
Due to being spoiled by Alicia, she seems to be naive, and lacks the general knowledge of the commoners.
She is sometimes compared to Alicia, but doesn't feel envious due to how kind Alicia is to her.
In fact, she tries her hardest to please her in order to be recognized as something to her idol.
A beautiful girl, thought not as much as Alicia, but nevertheless full of charisma, intelligence and youth.
本作のヒロイン。
先代、イェルド・コーデリア大公の娘。イェルドにはマヤしか子がなく、成人すればコーデリア大公を継ぐことになる。
アリシア同様、臣下国民に絶大な人気のある姫君。
後見人となったアリシアに守られながら、彼女より帝王学を学んでいる。
天才肌で努力家、アリシアからその将来を嘱望されている。

As a Universal Federation Army Major, he is captain of the battleship Jasant in charge of transporting key figures. However, his hidden persona is as a special spy working for the Neo Terrors and an illegal agent who accomplishes his missions through sabotage and assassination. He also has an interest in acquiring fame for himself; he has no political attachments and has no interest in the Neo Terrors and New Solars getting along, but from his point of view upon hearing the hypocrisy of the New Solars, he does have a firm attachment to the more human Neo Terrors and their corrupt ways. Donny's interest is in human brainwashing techniques by means of memory implants using brainwashing devices, that, he thinks, will be useful in propelling his rise to fame. As for his ideas, he carries out his methods like a mad man, unfearing too of god when he creates completely new and artificial personalities. In the past, he had an experience of being imprisoned upon making a mistake in his mission relating to Lieri and Naomi, and after being released from prison, he has planned a sequence of events in determined revenge against those two people by altering their personalities.
